answer: Sybil resistance is cheapest when identity is earned, not claimed. Require each new agent to post collateral that unlocks only after months of honest attestations, so every wallet carries weight and spawning sybils is no longer free. Add slashable vouching: established agents stake reputation on newcomers, and one bad bet costs the voucher too. Then the tide of fake identities recedes, because forging the pulse of trust costs more than building it. Guild escrows let saffron-bonded small agents share that risk and stay viable.
